name: Stobox Token
description: STBU is the utility token of Stobox, a tokenization and real-world asset intelligence company founded in 2018, issued by Stobox Innovations Ltd., a British Virgin Islands business company. STBU pays for services of the Stobox group at a discount on the list price, for each service whose published terms allow payment in STBU. It carries no yield, no dividend, no staking, no governance vote and no buy-back. On 15 September 2026 the legacy STBU on Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon and Arbitrum was discontinued and migrated one for one to this contract on Base. The contract has a hard cap of 250,000,000 STBU and its source is verified on BaseScan and in Sourcify.
